verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिरुवाच। यादृशः पुरुषस्यात्मा तादृशं संप्रभाषते। यथारूपोऽन्तरात्मा ते तथारूपं प्रभाषते ॥१॥
verses.english: Satyaki said As the inner nature of a man is, so he speaks. As your inner nature is, so do you speak.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ति वै पुरुषाः शूराः सन्ति का पुरुषास्तथा। उभावेतौ दृढौ पक्षौ दृश्येते पुरुषान्प्रति ॥२॥
verses.english: There are brave men and there are cowards. Both these well defined divisions are seen among human beings.
verses.bhavadeepa: यादृश इति । यादृश आत्मा शुद्धः पापो वा तादृशं शुद्धं पापं वा भाषते ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्नेव जायेते कुले क्लीबमहाबलौ। फलाफलवती शाखे यथैकस्मिन्वनस्पतौ ॥३॥
verses.english: In the same family are born very powerful men and powerless ones, as the same forest contains trees that bear fruits and those that do not.

verses.sanskrit: नाभ्यसूयामि ते वाक्यं ब्रुवतो लाङ्गलध्वज। ये तु शृण्वन्ति ते वाक्यं तानसूयामि माधव ॥४॥
verses.english: O you who have the sign of a slough on your standard, I am not finding fault with your speech; I am, O son of Madhu, only blaming these who are listening to it.
verses.bhavadeepa: फलाफलवती सुपो लुक् आर्षः पूर्वसवर्णो वा ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: कथं हि धर्मराजस्य दोषमल्पमपि ब्रुवन्। लभते परिषन्मध्ये व्याहर्तुमकुतोभयः॥५॥
verses.english: How can one, who even in the slightest degree speaks ill of the virtuous king, dare continue in that stain without being checked, in this assembly.
verses.bhavadeepa: ते तव वाक्यं तत्रापराधः शकुनेर्न कश्चिदिति पूर्वोक्तं कौरवपक्षपातयुक्तम् ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: समाहूय महात्मानं जितवन्तोऽक्षकोविदाः। अनक्षज्ञं यथाश्रद्धं तेषु धर्मजयः कुतः। यदि कुन्तीसुतं गेहे क्रीडन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह ॥६॥
verses.english: People, experts at the game of dice, challenged the noble minded one who was unskillful in the game and defeated him; how can this be a defeat in the proper sense?

verses.sanskrit: अभिगम्य जयेयुस्ते तत्तेषां धर्मतो भवेत्। समाहूय तु राजानं क्षत्रधर्मरतं सदा॥७॥
verses.english: If the son of Kunti had been playing with his brothers at home and those people coming there, defeated him, then that would have been a proper defeat. But they challenged the king who was ever attached to the observance of the rites of a Kshatriya. They won by a mean trick; how can prosperity attend such men? And why should those man here, after fulfilling his vow, approach them in a humiliating spirit.
verses.bhavadeepa: यथाश्रद्धं द्यूते आसक्तिरहितमिव धर्मे जयः धर्मनिमित्तं जयः कुतः । किं तु अधर्ममूलक एव तेषां जय इत्यर्थः ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्या जितवन्तस्ते किं नु तेषां परं शुभम्। कथं प्रणिपतेच्चायमिह कृत्वा पणं परम्॥८॥
वनवासाद्विमुक्तस्तु प्राप्तः पैतामहं पदम्। यद्ययं परवित्तानि कामयेत युधिष्ठिरः॥९॥
verses.english: Freed now from his cxile in the forest he has now attained to the position of his grandfather. Even if this Yudhishthira is secking property wrongfully, it is not proper that he should beg other people's property though it would be righteous on their part not to surrender the kingdom.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रणिपतेत् शरणागतो भवेत् । पणं कृत्वा वनवासप्रतिज्ञां निस्तीर्य ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमप्ययमत्यन्तं परान्नार्हति याचितुम्। कथं च धर्मयुक्तास्ते न च राज्यं जिहीर्षवः॥१०॥
निवृत्तवासान् कौन्तेयान् य आहुर्विदिता इति। अनुनीता हि भीष्मेण द्रोणेन विदुरेण च॥११॥
verses.english: Through Bhishina, Drona and Vidura have passed the prescribed period unknown in exile, yet have they said that they have been recognized.

verses.sanskrit: न व्यवस्यन्ति पाण्डूनां प्रदातुं पैतृकं वसु। अहं तु तान् शितैर्बाणैरनुनीय रणे बलात्॥१२॥
verses.english: They would not now consent to give back the ancestral territories of the Pandavas. And I shall persuade them by means of cold arrows in the field of battle.
verses.bhavadeepa: विदिता अज्ञातचर्यायामिति शेषः । अनुनीताः परिमितः काल एतैरतिवाहित इति बोधिताः ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: पादयोः पातयिष्यामि कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः। अथ ते न व्यवस्यन्ति प्रणिपाताय धीमतः॥१३॥
verses.english: And make them fall at the fect of the noble son of Kunti. If they refuse to fall at the feet of the wise (Yudhishthira).

verses.sanskrit: गमिष्यन्ति सहामात्या यमस्य सदनं प्रति। न हि ते युयुधानस्य संरब्धस्य युयुत्सतः॥१४॥
verses.english: Then must they with their ministers go to the kingdom of death (Yama); they cannot surely withstand Yuyudhana (myself) determined to fight.

verses.sanskrit: वेगं समर्थाः संसोढुं वज्रस्येव महीधराः। को हि गाण्डीवधन्वानं कश्च चक्रायुधं युधि॥१५॥
verses.english: Can the mountains bears the force of the thunderbolt? Who can bear the force of him who uses the Gandiva as his bow (Arjuna) and of him who has the wheel in his hand (Bhimasena)?

verses.sanskrit: मां चापि विषहेत्क्रुद्धं कश्च भीमं दुरासदम्। यमौ च दृढधन्वानौ यमकालोपमद्युती। विराटद्रुपदौ वीरौ यमकालोपमद्युती॥१६॥
verses.english: (Who can bear force of) myself when in wrath or of the Bhima who is hard to approach or of the twin brothers who firmly grasp the bow and whose effulgence is like that of Yama (who carries away life) and Kala (who cuts the thread of life) and the heroes Virates and Drupada who have the same quality?

verses.sanskrit: को जिजीविषुरासादेद्धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम्। पञ्चैतान् पाण्डवेयांस्तु द्रौपद्याः कीर्तिवर्धनान् ॥१७॥
verses.english: What man valuing his life can approach the descendant of Prishata Dhrishtadyumna also the five sons of the Pandavas who have added to Draupadi's glory.

verses.sanskrit: समप्रमाणान्पाण्डूनां समवीर्यान्मदोत्कटान्। सौभद्रं च महेष्वासममरैरपि दुःसहम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: And who are the equals of the Pandavas in valour and in every other respect and having the true pride of a soldier or (who can approach) the son of Subhadra, whose impetus is hard to be borne even by the gods.
verses.bhavadeepa: पाण्डवेयान् पाण्डवी द्रौपदी तत्पुत्रान् । पुंयोगलक्षणङीषन्तात् स्त्रीभ्यो ढगिति ढक् ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: गदप्रद्युम्नसाम्बांश्च कालसूर्यानलोपमान्। ते वयं धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रं शकुनिना सह ॥१९॥
verses.english: And (who can approach) Gada, Pradyumna and Samba resembling Kala, the son of the fire. We shall after killing the son of Dhritarashtra, with Shakuni and also Karna in battle appoint (as king) the Pandava. It is no sin to destroy an enemy who would have slain ourselves.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णं चैव निहत्याजावभिषेक्ष्याम पाण्डवम्। नाधर्मो विद्यते कश्चिच्छत्रून्हत्वाऽऽततायिनः ॥२०॥
अधर्म्यमयशस्यं च शात्रवाणां प्रयाचनम्। हृद्गतस्तस्य यः कामस्तं कुरुध्वमतन्द्रिताः ॥२१॥
verses.english: It is both impious and shameful to beg from enemies; do speedily, therefore that which is his (Yudhishthira's) heart-felt desire.

verses.sanskrit: निसृष्टं धार्तराष्ट्रेण राज्यं प्राप्नोतु पाण्डवः। अद्य पाण्डुसुतो राज्यं लभतां वा युधिष्ठिरः॥२२॥
verses.english: Let the Pandava get the kingdom surrendered by Dhritarashtra. This day cither shall Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu get the kingdom or all our enemies fall on the ground stain in battle.

verses.sanskrit: निहता वा रणे सर्वे स्वप्स्यन्ति वसुधातले ॥२३॥
